    # Flaechenfarben -> Tokens + Dark-Mode
    ("bg-white", "bg-surface"),
    ("text-[#0b1f3a]", "text-foreground"),

        "focus:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-accent/50 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-background",

    ("border-blue-600 bg-blue-600 text-white", "border-accent bg-accent text-white"),
    ("bg-blue-600", "bg-accent"),
    ("hover:bg-accent-700", "hover:bg-accent-hover"),  # Sicherheitsnetz falls Reihenfolge variiert
    ("hover:bg-blue-700", "hover:bg-accent-hover"),

    ("border-rose-300 bg-rose-50 text-rose-800",

    ("border-amber-300 bg-amber-50 text-amber-900",
     "border-amber-300 bg-amber-50 text-amber-900 dark:border-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-950 dark:text-amber-200"),

     "border-rose-300 bg-rose-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-rose-800 dark:border-rose-800 dark:bg-rose-950 dark:text-rose-300"),
    ("border-yellow-300 bg-yellow-50 px-3 text-xs font-semibold text-yellow-800 hover:bg-yellow-100",

    ("text-yellow-800", "text-yellow-800 dark:text-yellow-300"),
]

def main(paths):
    for path in paths:
        with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            text = fh.read()
        original = text

            print(f"geaendert: {path}")
